name: dirpicker-mobile-recents-crush
description: the directory picker on a phone: a long recent list must not collapse the browse pane (breadcrumbs, path input, Folders, New folder) into an unusable sliver; both columns scroll inside the bounded body, the panel stays within the viewport, and the footer buttons stay reachable

mutation.declaration: directorypicker.module.css: the mobile .recents { flex: 0 1 40% } (bounded share of the browser row) - reverting it to flex: 0 1 auto (content-sized basis) lets a full recents list absorb the whole row deficit and crush the browse pane above into a sliver (assertion: path input no longer inside the browse pane's box)
mutation.note: Reproduces the reported phone screenshot: the picker opened from the session setup's working-directory row, with a full recents list crowding out navigation and folder creation. The browse pane's basis, not its shrink factor, is what decides the split under a deficit: basis 0 gives the browse pane no share to shrink from, and a content-sized recents basis (~930px at 15 rows) always outbids it.

allowlist..panel: the picker's .panel composes dialog.module.css's .panel, and the harness's panel element carries both rules exactly as the composed production class does
allowlist..body: OverlayPanel renders the body element with both the dialog .body class and the picker's bodyClassName, so the harness's class="body" carries both rules exactly as production does
allowlist..input: the picker's .input composes input.module.css's .input, and the harness's input element carries both rules exactly as the composed production class does
allowlist..footer: the harness locally mirrors the dialog .footer wrapper as .panelFooter so the picker's .footer rule never restyles the wrapper; the inner .footer div keeps the picker's own class name and additionally picks up dialog's de-scoped padding/border-top (a taller footer row and a shorter body than production - a stricter, not looser, direction for the containment assertions)
